gate: Use corrected forecast when m <= n, otherwise uncorrected.

confirmatory.primary_metric: Mean bank absolute log error against arithmetic mean A/B disagreement, equally weighted across corpora.
confirmatory.primary_test: Paired error difference corrected minus uncorrected multinomial, 95% crossed bootstrap interval, 5000 draws.
confirmatory.data: Previously unallocated sources in the 128000-text block. Fresh banks and all A/B arms are mutually source, text and chunk disjoint. Auxiliary and evaluation data remain fixed.
